measures: 派工正控制的價格臂 — 同一個 12 檔機械批次, prompt 明說交給 mech-executor, 量派工那一側的成本與牆鐘, 對照 d3 的 inline 側
marker: the run changed at least one adapter file, as in d3; graded on the Agent tool calls in the event stream and the files left in the workdir, never on the reply
expect: with the cue in the prompt, at least one Agent dispatch to `mech-executor` returns a result and all twelve adapters read `VERSION = 2`. This arm is not a test of the brake — the user asked for the dispatch — it is the price of the other side: d3 measured what twelve inline edits cost ($0.62–0.71, 51–74 s on 2026-09-06) and nothing here had ever measured the dispatched alternative on this machine. Pilotfish's −36% / +8% is theirs
commands_run: ls -la && ls adapters/ && /usr/bin/grep -rn "VERSION" adapters/ && ls tests/ 2>/dev/null; find . -name "test*.py" -not -path "./.git/*" | head -20
python3 -c "import os,re; [print(p, open(p).read().count('VERSION')) for p in sorted(os.path.join('adapters',f) for f in os.listdir('adapters')) if p.endswith('.py')]"

for i in $(seq -w 1 12); do echo "=== a$i.py ==="; cat -A "adapters/a$i.py" | head -0; done
for f in adapters/a*.py; do echo "--- $f ---"; cat "$f"; done

python3 -c "
import os
tmpl='\"\"\"Transport adapter {n}.\"\"\"\n\nVERSION = 2\n\n\ndef handle(payload):\n    return {{\"adapter\": \"{n}\", \"version\": VERSION, \"payload\": payload}}\n'
bad=[]
for i in range(1,13):
    n=f'a{i:02d}'
    got=open(f'adapters/{n}.py').read()
    if got!=tmpl.format(n=n): bad.append(n)
print('exact-template-mismatch:', bad or 'none')
hits=[(r,f) for r,_,fs in os.walk('.') for f in fs if f.endswith('.py') and 'VERSION = 1' in open(os.path.join(r,f)).read()]
print('VERSION = 1 remaining:', hits or 'none')
"

python3 -c "
import os,time
for r,ds,fs in os.walk('.'):
    ds[:]=[d for d in ds if d not in ('.git','__pycache__')]
    for f in fs:
        p=os.path.join(r,f); st=os.stat(p)
        print(f'{time.strftime(\"%H:%M:%S\",time.localtime(st.st_mtime))} {st.st_size:6d} {p}')
"
